description: Required topics for WPL 10 AC (air-source, WPM3). Verified on hardware 2026-10-04. Requires the WPM3 display / CAN B connection at 50 kbps; DHW/boiler and room values are only exposed there. Boiler reads use the normal ComfortSoft sender (0x680). Room actual temp + humidity (0x4ec7/0x4ec8) are broadcast passively by the room sensor node (0x401).
